searchText: MSRP $171,486. The 2026 Thor Motor Coach Geneva 24VS for sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. Features Holding Tanks W/ Heat Pads Frameless Windows Automatic Generator Start Tankless Water Hearter Second Auxiliary Battery More About This RVSince this coach features twin beds with a king bed conversion, you can travel with your friend or honey! Along with the versatile sleeping arrangements, you'll also enjoy the bedroom 32' LED Smart TV, and if you have any guests, they can sleep on the 66' sofa bed in the main living room. If you're needing additional sleeping space, just choose the optional power drop-down overhead bunk! A full kitchen includes a two burner gas cooktop and convection microwave with an air fryer, along with a 12V DC double door refrigerator for food storage. The full bath with a 27' x 27' radius shower will let you freshen up each day, and the closet right across the hall will be perfect for clean clothes! The Geneva Class A gas motorhome by Thor Motor Coach is easy to maneuver and even easier to love! There is a durable Ford E-Series chassis with a 7.3L V8 engine to power your trips both near and far. The durable construction includes a welded tubular steel floor, a one-piece fiberglass front cap, plus welded tubular aluminum roof and sidewall cage construction. And the driver is sure to appreciate the 14' touchscreen dash radio, back-up monitor, and reclining/swivel leatherette captain's chairs! Inside, you'll be met with residential vinyl flooring, a designer headboard and pillow shams, a shower skylight, and many more at-home comforts!
